dedupe_keys.name: national water data portal of india nwic 558 open hydrological datasets

description: The National Water Data Portal run by the National Water Informatics Centre lists 558 datasets on the day read, filterable by location, data producer and group, with map tiles credited to Stadia Maps and OpenStreetMap. Entries include monthly manual hydro-meteorological observations, daily rainfall from the India Meteorological Department and Karnataka stations, daily river discharge gauges, daily manual reservoir data, groundwater level series manual and telemetry every six hours, and hourly telemetry of humidity, pressure and wind from state water departments such as Karnataka, Haryana and West Bengal. Each dataset can be downloaded as CSV, TSV, JSON or XML. Coverage: national in intent, though the listings seen were dominated by a few states. Access: free; the licence is not stated on the listing page. Caveats: the page is a listing, so per-dataset periods, licences and completeness were not checked. It supports reservoir, discharge and groundwater analysis for flood and irrigation planning, and relates to the India-WRIS record in the catalogue.
